environment.identity: not collected because this is a plan

host_accounting.accounting_scope: Board-free host model: circular-buffer pages, resident tensors, largest assigned core, and static L1 prefix. These are not device measurements.

first_launch_plan.purpose: Launch the new FP32-R kernel once under Watcher before any timing comparison.

rows.name: fp32-r-L32-r-dram
rows.configuration_note: Nearest fitting placement for the selected block-8 default; no silent fallback is performed.

metrics.latency: per-launch latency in milliseconds from 1000 synchronized launches
metrics.tflops: fixed-N=12 useful workload divided by measured latency
metrics.inverse_error: relative Frobenius error against the matching independent NumPy reference and against the true inverse
metrics.mv_direction: weight-direction cosine deficit where the existing reference records it
metrics.beam_pattern: beam-pattern difference where the existing reference records it

correctness.true_inverse: NumPy complex128 inverse of the unrounded deterministic R

measurement_provenance_to_capture.watcher_and_timeout: record effective settings for the first launch and timing comparison

decision_scope: Evidence only. This plan does not select BF16-R or FP32-R and does not change ADR-0012, ADR-0013, or the 1e-2 device gate.
limitations: No board, container, device node, or hardware command was used to create this record.
Latency, TFLOPS, inverse, MV-direction, and beam-pattern measurements remain null until the owner-authorized board run.
The FP32-R L=32 timing row uses explicit R-in-DRAM placement because the default R-in-L1 preflight rejects before allocation; block 2 with R in L1 is also recorded as an explicit fitting alternative.
